data.title: Iris Energy Deadline Alert
data.summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP is investigating potential claims against Iris Energy Limited (NASDAQ: IREN) and reminds investors of the February 13, 2023 deadline to seek the role of lead plaintiff in a federal securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that Iris Energy's IPO offering documents and public statements were false and misleading, particularly regarding the ability of certain Bitcoin miners to service their debt obligations, which led to a significant stock price drop. Investors who suffered losses exceeding $100,000 are encouraged to contact Faruqi & Faruqi to discuss their legal options.

data.title: DEADLINE REMINDER: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Investigates Claims on Behalf of Investors of Iris Energy
data.summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP is investigating potential claims against Iris Energy Limited (NASDAQ: IREN) and reminds investors of the December 6, 2024, deadline to seek the role of lead plaintiff in a federal securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that Iris Energy and its executives made false and misleading statements regarding the company's prospects with data centers and high-performance computing, specifically concerning material deficiencies at its Childress County, Texas site. Investors who suffered losses exceeding $75,000 between June 20, 2023, and July 11, 2024, are encouraged to contact the firm.
